name: Michelle Obama
role: Lawyer, author and advocate; First Lady of the United States (2009-2017)
summary: Michelle Obama, a lawyer and former US first lady, launched Let’s Move to improve childhood nutrition and encourage physical activity and co-founded When We All Vote to expand voter participation. She has defended legal abortion, marriage equality and race-conscious college admissions.
